description: This file defines factory functions for creating various types of selection list components (select list, searchable select list, filterable select list, settings list) for a terminal user interface. It imports necessary types and themes, and exports functions that instantiate these components with specific configurations.

methods.name: export function createSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSelectList
methods.description: Creates a SelectList component with a specified list of items and maximum visible items.

methods.name: export function createSearchableSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSearchableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a SearchableSelectList component with a specified list of items and maximum visible items.

methods.name: export function createFilterableSelectList(items: FilterableSelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createFilterableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a FilterableSelectList component with a specified list of items and maximum visible items.

methods.name: export function createSettingsList( createSettingsList
methods.description: Creates a SettingsList component with specified items, callbacks for change and cancel, and maximum visible items.
